versions.comment: Add sanitizer toggle for debug builds
versions.content:
option(ENABLE_SANITIZERS "Build with address sanitizer" OFF)
if(ENABLE_SANITIZERS)
  add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address)
  add_link_options(-fsanitize=address)
endif()

# Basename globs refused by the NO_BUILD_ARTIFACTS mkelem trigger (read by block_artifacts.sh)
*.o
*.obj
*.a
*.lib
*.so
*.dll
*.exe
*.pdb
*.log
*.tmp
*.bak
*~
Thumbs.db
.DS_Store

#!/bin/sh
# Pre-op trigger on mkelem: refuse build output and view-private leftovers.
# ClearCase sets CLEARCASE_PN (path being added) and CLEARCASE_USER.
DENYLIST=/vobs/build_common/triggers/mkelem_denylist.txt
name=`basename "$CLEARCASE_PN"`
while read pattern; do
  case "$pattern" in
    ''|\#*) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$name" in
    $pattern)
      echo "mkelem blocked for $CLEARCASE_USER: '$name' matches deny pattern '$pattern'" >&2
      exit 1 ;;
  esac
done < "$DENYLIST"
exit 0
